identity_rules.content_id_registry: P22 remains owner; UX IDs never replace content IDs
identity_rules.dynamic_key: Unpadded base64url of exact UTF-8 instance id; reject empty/NUL; never use localized display text or hand position as persistent identity
identity_rules.reordering: slot is identity only for party slot control; unit/card identity follows instance id across reorder
identity_rules.reuse: do not reuse retired semantic anchor for another purpose
identity_rules.widget_uniqueness: Distinct widgets on one screen have distinct fixed anchor IDs, even when they navigate to the same destination. Dynamic templates expand by instance key before binding. Text children may reference their parent semantic anchor without becoming a second geometry owner.

geometry.coordinate_space: viewport logical pixels; CSS px in current browser reference; top-left origin; engine adapter must define matching logical unit
geometry.position: signed finite x/y; positive finite width/height; use visible clipped intersection
geometry.dpr: do not multiply by devicePixelRatio twice; device pixel conversion belongs only at renderer boundary
geometry.lifetime: P19 owns rect sampling; no stale rect reused across layout/visibility revision
geometry.missing_origin_after_commit: skip flight if original hand card no longer has a valid current rect; retain hit/actual log only when valid; precommit origin geometry requires an accepted extension
geometry.missing_target: skip presentation, keep current snapshot; never infer another target
geometry.safe_margins: 24 logical px at design reference, may reflow with actual target approval

compatibility.canonical_namespace_transport: sidecar design map only; NOT inserted into closed P13 or current P19 payload

data_channels: P14 committed events -> P29 decorative overlay
P23 geometry semantics -> P19 sampling -> P29 read-only numbers
